channel.title: Weinstock Vision: Articles by Dr. Robert J. Weinstock
channel.description: Plain-language guides to cataracts, vision correction and coverage.

item.title: 7 Signs It May Be Time for Cataract Surgery
item.dc:creator: Robert J. Weinstock, MD
item.description: Blurry vision, glare, faded colors and trouble driving at night can all signal a cataract. Largo cataract surgeon Dr. Robert Weinstock explains the 7 signs and when surgery makes sense.

item.title: LASIK vs. EVO ICL: How to Know Which Fits You
item.dc:creator: Robert J. Weinstock, MD
item.description: LASIK reshapes the cornea. EVO ICL places a thin lens inside the eye. Largo refractive surgeon Dr. Robert Weinstock compares candidacy, recovery and who each procedure fits best.

item.title: What Medicare Covers for Cataract Surgery
item.dc:creator: Robert J. Weinstock, MD
item.description: Medicare Part B covers cataract surgery with a conventional lens. Learn what you pay, how premium lenses work, what Medicare Advantage covers and the glasses benefit after surgery.
